[![LiDAR survey over a forested area (source: Felix Rohrbach)](lidar.jpg "LiDAR survey over a forested area (source: Felix Rohrbach)")][blog]

[Felix Rohrbach][felix], graduate of ETH Zurich[^ethz] and currently working as a 
Senior Product Engineer for Esri in Finland, runs a [personal blog][blog] in 
which he has been chipping away at the theory behind and questions around LiDAR[^lidar]
technology and applications. The blog is prolific at around three posts per week. A 
small sample of the topics covered so far include:

- [An introduction to LiDAR](https://tech.rohrba.ch/introduction-to-lidar/)
- [Four essential LiDAR parameters](https://tech.rohrba.ch/four-essential-lidar-parameters/)
- [Surveying altitude](https://tech.rohrba.ch/surveying-altitude/)
- [A closer look at LAS formats](https://tech.rohrba.ch/a-closer-look-at-las-formats/)
- [Understanding scan patterns](https://tech.rohrba.ch/scan-pattern/)
- [Ellipsoidal and orthometric heights in LiDAR data](https://tech.rohrba.ch/ellipsoidal-orthometric-heights-lidar/)
- [A closer look at Europe’s national LiDAR programs](https://tech.rohrba.ch/a-closer-look-at-europes-national-lidar-programs/)

Topics also include more specialised background knowledge as well as adjacent 
areas of interest:

- [Fundamentals of aircraft speed](https://tech.rohrba.ch/aircraft-speed/)
- [Level of detail in 3D city models](https://tech.rohrba.ch/level-of-detail-in-3d-city-models/)
- [3D Gaussian splatting](https://tech.rohrba.ch/3d-gaussian-splatting-explained/)[^3d-gaussian-splatting][&nbsp;explained](https://tech.rohrba.ch/3d-gaussian-splatting-explained/)
- [GNSS](https://tech.rohrba.ch/gnss-and-imu-trajectory-quality/)[^gnss][&nbsp;and&nbsp;](https://tech.rohrba.ch/gnss-and-imu-trajectory-quality/)[IMU](https://tech.rohrba.ch/gnss-and-imu-trajectory-quality/)[^imu][&nbsp;trajectory quality](https://tech.rohrba.ch/gnss-and-imu-trajectory-quality/)

There is much more in Felix's blog, and it is well worth a visit if you are 
interested in LiDAR technology and its applications.

[felix]: https://www.linkedin.com/in/felixrohrbach
[blog]: https://tech.rohrba.ch

[^ethz]: ETHZ is the Zurich branch of the Swiss Federal Institute for Technology.
[^lidar]: Light Detection and Ranging, an active remote sensing technique that uses laser pulses to generate 3D point clouds of the Earth's surface or objects.
[^3d-gaussian-splatting]: A technique that represents and renders 3D scenes as many small, semi-transparent 3D Gaussian "blobs" learned from images.
[^gnss]: Global Navigation Satellite System. For example: Galileo or GPS.
[^imu]: Inertial Measurement Unit, a sensor that combines accelerometers and gyroscopes to measure a platform's orientation and motion.
